2.0.2.heading: One small tab, a clearer Home
2.0.2.edge: One small tab on the left edge of your screen replaces the Rail. Hover it to see your limits and agents. On Linux Wayland the tray takes its place.
2.0.2.home: Home shows the account you are signed in with now, one card per tool. Anything that cannot be measured waits on Connections with one fix.
2.0.2.statusline: The terminal status line leaves out the folder and any provider that cannot be measured right now.

2.0.1.heading: Startup fix
2.0.1.startup: Fixes a freeze at startup on Windows.

2.0.0.heading: Your limits and agents, in view
2.0.0.rail: The left edge Rail keeps your readings in view on Windows. The macOS and Linux Rail is a preview; the tray remains available.
2.0.0.activity: See when a supported agent is busy, waiting for you, or done. Local activity and usage alerts are free.
2.0.0.statusline: The terminal status line uses the same band colours as your meters. Toggles let you choose which providers appear.
2.0.0.cursor: Cursor is Experimental. Live account verification is still required, and a missing quota stays unavailable.
2.0.0.retry: The desktop and CLI share one retry policy. Refresh respects provider retry deadlines and keeps the last reading with its original time.
2.0.0.sessions: Phone and browser sessions handle renewal, pairing and reconnects more reliably. Older readings remain clearly marked when a computer stops syncing.
2.0.0.spend: The local monthly spend cap is removed. Local spend readings remain free, with one active account per provider.
